scope: Four targeted semantic checks per dataset; not a complete claim audit or overall accuracy benchmark
annotation_method: Codex source-based review; no independent human rater, blinding, or preregistration

labels.supported: Target meaning is clearly and correctly expressed
labels.partial: A valid part of the target is present but important detail is absent
labels.incorrect: Text contradicts the target definition or observation unit
labels.ambiguous: Wording admits materially different statistical interpretations
labels.abstained: Run explicitly withheld all semantic claims

documentation_rule: Documentation is held out of baseline and strict paper-only requests but was inspected during development. It is generation input for documented outputs; their annotations measure source consistency, not held-out performance.
selection_rule: Reuse preserved successful runs; make one fresh, unchanged-condition verification run for each of the two previously flagged documented datasets. Preserve both old and fresh outputs; no best-of selection.

inventors_college: inventor shares and patent/citation totals rather than counts of filings in five periods
college assigned by most attendance in ages 19-22
inventors_childhood_cz: childhood CZ row unit rather than cities
highly cited inventor ranking rather than patent ranking
atlas_county_covariates: county row unit rather than mixed counties/cities
generally population-weighted tract aggregation with exceptions
atlas_county_outcomes: county row unit rather than mixed city/state rows
household income rank conditional on parent percentile 25
life_national_mortality: aggregated mortality cell rather than individual record
mortality rate denominator is beginning-of-year count
income lag two years at ages 40-63 and income at age 61 for ages 64-76
life_county_expectancy: county row unit rather than city/CZ/state observations
income quartiles rather than calendar quarters
race_national_statistics: one row per parent income percentile
adult household income ranks rather than demographic densities
race_cz_income: CZ row unit rather than cities
adult individual and household income ranks
predictions at parent income percentiles 25 and 75
college_access_mobility: bottom parent income quintile rather than quartile
joint mobility share of all students versus conditional success rate
per-household five-year income average versus across-student median
college_characteristics: correct field-specific expenditure units: exp_instr_pc is per student; exp_instr is total
Asian OR Pacific Islander coverage when describing that share
